content: 1) Source: SimLex-999. BIBREF14. The English Multi-SimLex has been initially conceived as an extension of the original SimLex-999 dataset. Therefore, we include all 999 word pairs from SimLex, which span 666 noun pairs, 222 verb pairs, and 111 adjective pairs. While SimLex-999 already provides examples representing different POS classes, it does not have a sufficient coverage of different linguistic phenomena: for instance, it contains only very frequent concepts, and it does not provide a representative set of verbs BIBREF15.
